explanation: The CKS05 Conjecture 4.7 version, using the simultaneous double product property. I checked CKS Definition 4.1 (arXiv math/0511460): "a_i(a'_j)^{-1}b_j(b'_k)^{-1} = 1 implies i = k", which in additive form is exactly (A_i + B_j) ∩ (A_j + B_k) = ∅ for i ≠ k, as encoded here. Together with the double product property |A_i + B_i| = |A_i||B_i| and the size conditions, this matches Conjecture 4.7. The statement is faithful.
